ledger.claim: The driver's own GPS trace never brings him anywhere near the pickup pin. Across 49 fixes his closest approach is 177.53 m from the pin, with a mean of 180.78 m and a maximum of 184.39 m, against a 120 m arrival radius for a LARGE_VENUE pickup such as The Cascadia guardhouse. On the POL-NS-02 proximity test there is not one admissible in-radius fix, so the driver never arrived.

Because the driver never entered the geofence, POL-NS-01 fails at limb (b) (no in-geofence fix at or before the 'arrived' event) and again at limb (c): the trace records 0 qualifying in-geofence fixes and a longest qualifying run of 0.0 seconds against the 300-second minimum dwell for LARGE_VENUE. The clause is conjunctive and requires all four conditions; breaking one is enough, and two are broken.

The dwell shortfall is total rather than marginal: effective in-geofence dwell is 0 seconds against a required 300 seconds, a shortfall of 300 seconds. Under POL-NS-06 a dwell shorter than the zone minimum means the cancellation fee is not chargeable and is refunded to the rider in full, whether or not the rider was present and whether or not she responded to messages.

In the alternative the facts sit squarely inside POL-NS-03's wrong-entrance band. The driver held position at roughly 180 m from the pin for the whole waiting window (speeds between 0.0 and 2.3 kph) — outside the 120 m arrival radius but well inside the 400 m ceiling that is the whole test — so POL-NS-03 refunds the cancellation fee to the rider in full on the same basis as POL-NS-02.

No driver compensation attaches under POL-NS-03. Fault is allocated from the chat log for compensation only, and limb (i) applies: the rider named the meeting point in the chat log — 'pin is the guardhouse where every driver stops. please come in' — and the driver never moved to it before cancelling at 09:23:50. Limb (ii) cannot apply either, because the trip records only 1 registered pickup point, not 2 or more, so there is no pin-ambiguity goodwill to pay.

The rider did everything the platform asks of her. Her device track is available and places her within 10.24 m of the pin at her furthest, across 42 qualifying fixes spanning the whole waiting window, against a 150 m rider-presence radius for LARGE_VENUE. She was at the guardhouse; this is not a rider who failed to show.

I will not stretch POL-NS-04, and it does not carry this case. Limbs (a) and (c) are met — the rider sent a coordinating message at 09:20:20 and was inside the presence radius — but limb (b) is defeated, because the driver placed an in-app voice call at 09:18:40, answered for 65 seconds, before terminating the trip. The rider therefore rests on the geofence failure under POL-NS-01, POL-NS-02, POL-NS-03 and POL-NS-06, none of which depends on POL-NS-04.

The driver's 'your pin wrong' defence — repeated in his chat message and his filed statement — is not supported by the record. The trip's own pickup label is 'The Cascadia, 305 Bukit Timah Rd (Guardhouse)', the trip records a single registered pickup point, and the rider's chat identifies the guardhouse as the meeting point. Nothing in the evidence establishes a second entrance or face of the building he was entitled to hold at.

There is no traffic advisory covering this pickup road: EV-ADVIS-00620-01 is MISSING and carries weight 0.0. POL-NS-06 limb (i) requires a present and populated advisory of an admissible type before separate in-geofence intervals may be summed, so no accumulation is available and the 0-second dwell stands unimpeached.

ledger.claim: Compensation to the driver is not payable. POL-NS-07 compensates only where POL-NS-01 is satisfied in full, and it is not satisfied on any limb (b), (c) or (d). For completeness, the POL-NS-07 anti-farming check would not bite in any event: 1 no-show termination in 30 days against 110 completed trips is far below the 4-termination and 0.08-rate thresholds, so no escalation is triggered on that limb.

The amount to be returned is the full SGD 4.00 cancellation fee. The fare ledger shows a 4.00 cancellation_fee line, which reconciles with the fee schedule's greater-of test for this trip (LARGE_VENUE zone fee 4.00 and RYDE_X vehicle-tier fee 4.00 both produce 4.00). There is no fare defect under POL-NS-08(d) and no basis to discount the refund; the rider has paid it (payment_status CHARGED) and refund_issued_sgd is 0.00.

Nothing in this record requires escalation under POL-NS-09. No limb (a)-(d) impairment under POL-NS-08 is present (no clock skew, no sampling gap over 120 seconds, no chat defect, fare reconciles), the parties have 0 prior no-show disputes with each other in 90 days, the rider has 0 no-show disputes in 30 days, and the deciding facts rest on complete weight-1.0 telemetry. The case is decidable now, on a full refund.

The rider's exoneration route under POL-NS-04 fails at limb (b). Her only locating message was sent at 09:20:20, but the driver had already placed a 65-second in-app voice call at 09:18:40 which the rider answered, and that call is recorded in trip_record.in_app_calls before the 09:23:50 cancellation. Limb (b) requires that the driver neither replied within 120 seconds nor placed an in-app call at any point before terminating the trip; the recorded call defeats it, so POL-NS-04 does not apply and the residual mislocation is dealt with under POL-NS-03.

There is no false arrival marker here, and the rider cannot obtain one. At the 09:17:52 arrival event the driver's own trace places him between 177.5 m and 184.4 m from the pin - well inside the 300 m ceiling - while travelling at 0.0 to 2.3 kph, far below the 15 kph motion trigger. POL-NS-05 is not engaged, no false-arrival referral is available against this driver, and the case is a POL-NS-03 wrong-entrance matter.

The driver did not abandon the pickup. His trace is 100 percent covered, 49 fixes with no gap and no interval longer than the 10 second cadence, and it shows a continuous essentially stationary hold from 09:15:40 to 09:23:40 - about 480 seconds - at a mean of 180.8 m from the pin, squarely inside POL-NS-03's 400 m wrong-entrance ceiling. On POL-NS-03's own terms this is a wrong-face-of-the-venue case, not a driver who was never at the venue; the geofence failure is a POL-NS-03 question and not evidence of desertion.

The POL-NS-07 anti-farming branch is not triggered. driver_profile.no_show_terminations_30d is 1, below the threshold of 4, and 1 divided by 110 completed trips is 0.009, far below the 0.08 rate cap. Both limbs must hold, so neither does: the driver's fee is not withheld on this ground and POL-NS-09(d) does not escalate this case for driver-side abuse.

On POL-NS-03's fault allocation, limb (i) is not made out, so the loss is not laid at the driver's door. The pickup label already reads 'The Cascadia, 305 Bukit Timah Rd (Guardhouse)', and the rider's only message merely restated that same pin - 'pin is the guardhouse where every driver stops. please come in' - naming no entrance, block or tower beyond the label the driver already had. The rider supplied no sub-location that the driver failed to move to.

ruling.explanation:
Both parties: the SGD 4.00 no-show cancellation fee is refunded to the rider in full. The driver never reached the pickup pin. His own GPS trace (EV-GPS-00620, 49 fixes, no gaps, 10 s cadence) places him between 177.5 m and 184.4 m from the pin for the whole waiting window 09:15:40 to 09:23:40, and never inside the 120 m arrival radius for this LARGE_VENUE pickup (The Cascadia guardhouse). Under POL-NS-02 there is not one admissible in-radius fix, so the driver is not deemed to have arrived, and POL-NS-01 fails at limb (b) and again at limb (c): the trace records 0 in-geofence fixes and a longest qualifying dwell of 0.0 s against the 300 s minimum. Because the driver was nonetheless stationary for a continuous 480 s at about 180 m from the pin - outside the 120 m radius but well inside the 400 m ceiling - POL-NS-03 governs, its distance test is met, and it refunds the cancellation fee in full. POL-NS-06 reaches the same result independently: effective in-geofence dwell of 0 s against 300 s required is a 300 s shortfall, and the fee is not chargeable. The missing traffic advisory (EV-ADVIS-00620-01, weight 0.0) is why separate in-geofence intervals cannot be summed and seconds cannot be accumulated, but here there are none to sum. On the driver's points: I accept the arrival marker was not false - at 09:17:52 he was about 180 m from the pin, under the 300 m trigger, and moving at 0.0-2.3 kph, under the 15 kph trigger - so POL-NS-05 is not engaged and no false-arrival referral is made. I accept POL-NS-04 does not carry the rider: her coordinating message at 09:20:20 was preceded by the driver's answered 65-second in-app call at 09:18:40, which defeats limb (b). I accept the anti-farming check does not bite (1 no-show termination against 110 completed trips), so POL-NS-09(d) does not escalate. But none of this helps the driver, because his own trace defeats the fee under POL-NS-02, POL-NS-03 and POL-NS-06. No driver compensation is payable: POL-NS-07 pays only where POL-NS-01 is satisfied in full, and it is not. Under POL-NS-03 the trip records a single registered pickup point, so the pin-ambiguity goodwill is unavailable, and the rider did identify the guardhouse as the meeting point, so the loss sits with the driver; his 'wrong pin' account in chat and in his filed statement is not supported by the record. Deciding facts rest on the GPS trace and trip record, both weight 1.0, and no POL-NS-08 impairment applies - no clock skew, no trace gap, no chat defect, and the 4.00 fee reconciles with the greater-of test (LARGE_VENUE 4.00, RYDE_X 4.00) - so the case is decidable without escalation. The full 4.00 charged is returned; refund_issued_sgd remains 0.00 until processed.

The judge was asked 4 times on the same inputs and every draft agreed on this ruling, so it is carried unanimously (vote agreement 1.00).
